name: rosetta-arithmetic-mean
code:
use default

mean(values: List[double]) -> double =>
    values |> reduce(0.0D, (total, value) => total + value) /
    cast(values.count)

write_line("mean: {mean([1.0D, 2.0D, 3.0D, 4.0D, 5.0D]):F1}")
fullSource:
use default

mean(values: List[double]) -> double =>
    values |> reduce(0.0D, (total, value) => total + value) /
    cast(values.count)

write_line("mean: {mean([1.0D, 2.0D, 3.0D, 4.0D, 5.0D]):F1}")
